question: Which of the following shortcut key is used to save a file in MS-Word 365?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To save a file in **MS-Word 365, **you can use the **"Ctrl + S" **shortcut key on Windows or** "Command + S" **on Mac.
 
• This will bring up the Save As dialog box, where you can choose a location to save the file and enter a file name.
 
• You can also use the** "Ctrl + Shift + S"** shortcut key on Windows o**r "Command + Shift + S"** on Mac to quickly save the file with the current file name and location.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** MS-Word 365 **is the latest version of **Microsoft Word**, which is a** word processing software used for creating, editing, formatting, and sharing text-based documents.**
 
• It is part of the** Microsoft Office 365** suite of productivity applications and is available on **Windows and Mac computers, as well as mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets.**
 
• **MS-Word 365** offers a wide range of features and tools for creating** professional-looking documents, including templates, styles, formatting options, and collaboration tools.**
 
• It also includes support for cloud storage services such as **OneDrive and SharePoint,** allowing users to access and edit their documents from anywhere with an internet connection.
 
• Additionally, **MS-Word 365** includes intelligent features such as the Editor, which provides advanced grammar and spelling suggestions, and the Design Ideas feature, which suggests visual enhancements for your documents.
